This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

What’s for dinner tonight? A little taste of sunshine in a pot! 🍋 This Greek lemon chicken and potatoes is an easy weeknight dinner where the oven does all the hard work. Served with a fresh Greek salad, it’s a meal I come back to time and time again. Definitely a family favorite! Prep time: 20 minutes  Bake time: 2 hours  Yields: 7-8 servings  Ingredients: 4 to 5 golden potatoes, peeled and quartered (3 lbs) 7 pieces of chicken (bone-in thighs and drumsticks work beautifully, but use your favorite!) (2 lbs. 10 oz )  You can also use boneless pieces as well, reduce bake time by 30 minutes.  For the sauce: Juice of 2 large lemons about 1/2 cup  1/4 cup good-quality olive oil 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 6 garlic cloves, minced 2 to 3 tsp salt A few sprigs of fresh oregano or 1 tbsp. Dried oregano  1/4 cup water  Dairy free Greek salad:  6 Persian cucumbers  3 beefsteak tomatoes  1 red pepper  1/2 red onion  1 cup pitted Kalamata olives  1 bunch flat head parsley  Dressing:  1/3 cup olive oil  1/4 cup fresh lemon juice  2 tbsp. Red wine vinegar  2 minced garlic cloves  1 tbsp. dried oregano  2 tsp. salt  1 tsp. black pepper  Instructions: Prep the chicken and potatoes:  Peel and rinse your golden potatoes, then cut them into large wedges. Wash and pat dry your chicken pieces. Layer in your pot: Arrange the chicken pieces in a large oven-safe pot or braiser (I use a 14-inch cast iron). Lay the potato wedges on top.  Tip: If your pot has plastic handles, wrap them in foil and you're good to go in the oven. No oven-safe lid? Cover with parchment and foil. Make the sauce: In a jar, combine the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, salt, and oregano. Give it a good shake until everything is well mixed and emulsified. Assemble: Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken and potatoes. Add 1/4 cup water to the jar, mix again and pour over.  Bake: Cover and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Finish uncovered: After 1.5 hours, remove the lid, baste the chicken and potatoes with those delicious juices, and return to the oven uncovered for 30 minutes, until everything is golden and caramelized. While the chicken is baking, prepare the salad. Combine everything in a bowl.  Prepare the dressing in the sane jar as the sauce for the chicken. Mix well and dress salad.  Toss and enjoy ❤️ Every bite is bursting with flavor — fresh, zesty, and comforting. Let the oven do the work, and enjoy a little taste of Greece right at home. #onepanmeal #sivanskitchen #easyrecipe #greekchicken #chickenandpotatoes

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. My Creamy Chicken & Leek pie is just what you need on a cold day✨🥧🍂  Here’s The Full Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients 600g chicken breast, diced 1 tbsp olive oil 1 leek, finely chopped 1 onion, diced 200g chestnut mushrooms, sliced 3 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 500ml chicken stock  100g cream cheese 50g smoked Applewood cheese, grated 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp dried oregano Salt and black pepper, to taste 1 sheet ready-rolled puff pastry 1 egg, beaten (for the egg wash) Instructions 1. Season the chicken: Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with paprika, dried oregano, salt and black pepper. Mix well to coat evenly. 2. Brown the chicken: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and fry until golden on the outside. It doesn’t need to be fully cooked through at this stage. Simmer the filling: Return the chicken to the pan and simmer gently for around 10–15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has reduced slightly. 6. Tender pulled chicken in a rich, smoky chilli sauce with peppers and kidney beans served over fluffy rice and topped with melted cheddar and creamy avocado🤌🏼  Makes 2 servings 🤍Ingredients🤍 	⁃	200g chicken breast 	⁃	1/2 brown onion, diced 	⁃	1/2 red bell pepper, diced 	⁃	1/2 green bell pepper, diced 	⁃	200g kidney beans 	⁃	400g chopped tomatoes 	⁃	30g tomato purée 	⁃	300ml chicken stock 	⁃	50g cheddar cheese, grated 	⁃	1 tsp chilli powder 	⁃	1 tsp smoked paprika 	⁃	1 tsp mixed herbs 	⁃	1/2 tsp garlic powder 	⁃	1/2 tsp onion granules 	⁃	1 tsp olive oil 	⁃	Salt & pepper 	⁃	120g basmati rice (cooked weight) 	⁃	50g avocado  ⭐️METHOD⭐️ 	⁃	Season your chicken breast with a pinch of salt and pepper then pop in the oven or airfryer at 200°C for around 25 minutes until cooked through and no longer pink. 	⁃	Meanwhile, cook your basmati rice according to the packet instructions or use precooked rice for convenience. 	⁃	Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat then add your diced onion and peppers then cook until softened and golden. 	⁃	Add the kidney beans and cook for a couple of minutes before stirring through the tomato purée, chopped tomatoes and chicken stock. 	⁃	Add the chilli powder, smoked paprika, mixed herbs, garlic powder, onion granules, salt and pepper. Give everything a good stir and leave to simmer over a medium heat until the sauce has thickened slightly. 	⁃	Once your chicken is cooked, use two forks to pull it apart until completely shredded then stir it through the chilli mixture until beautifully coated in that rich sauce. 	⁃	Divide the fluffy rice between two bowls, spoon over the pulled chilli chicken and finish with grated cheddar and sliced avocado. Serve and enjoy!!😍  ✨CALORIES: 688 ✨PROTEIN: 49g ✨CARBS: 90g ✨FAT: 16g For even more cosy dinner ideas, head over to my @kirstyskitchenclub app, where you'll find 500+ easy, delicious recipes to make eating well feel EASY!! Creamy Chicken in 20 Minutes! Weeknights can get a little hectic, and sometimes you just need something quick and easy for dinner! Nothing beats a good chicken dinner, especially when it looks and tastes like something you’d order at a nice Italian restaurant! The best part is you don’t have to spend hours in the kitchen to make something this good. Pollo alla Valdostana Ingredients 1 lb (450 g) thin chicken cutlets 1/4 lb (115 g) prosciutto cotto (Italian cooked ham) 1/3 lb (150 g) Fontina cheese, shredded 1/2 cup white wine 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable broth (plus an extra 1/2 cup for more sauce) Flour Extra virgin olive oil Knob of butter Salt and pepper Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Heat olive oil and a knob of butter in a pan over medium-high heat. 2. While the butter melts, lightly flour the chicken cutlets and place them directly into the pan. 3. Cook for about 2 minutes per side, seasoning with salt and pepper. 4. Add the white wine and let it reduce for a minute or two. 5. Pour in the broth, then top each cutlet with prosciutto cotto, Fontina cheese, and fresh parsley. 6. Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, the cheese melts, and the sauce thickens. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

♡ STUPID EASY DINNERS ♡ Episode 2; Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Alfredo A cozy, creamy homemade Alfredo that tastes like restaurant takeout but is surprisingly easy to make! 🤎 INGREDIENTS Serves 4 Chicken * 2 large chicken breasts (450–570 g), sliced into thin cutlets * 1 tsp Italian seasoning * ½ tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp paprika * ¾ tsp salt * ¼ tsp black pepper * 1 tbsp olive oil * 1 tbsp salted butter Alfredo Sauce * 2 tbsp salted butter (28 g) * 4 garlic cloves, minced * 1½ cups heavy cream (360 ml) * 1 cup freshly grated Parmesan (90–100 g) * Black pepper, to taste * Optional: pinch of nutmeg * Fresh parsley, for garnish * 12 oz (340 g) gluten-free fettuccine INSTRUCTIONS 1. Season chicken with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper. 2. Heat olive oil and butter in a skillet over medium heat. Cook chicken for 4–5 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through to 165°F (74°C). Remove and set aside. 3. Cook gluten-free fettuccine according to package instructions. Reserve ½ cup pasta water before draining. 4. In the same skillet, melt 2 tbsp butter. Add garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in heavy cream and gently simmer for 3–5 minutes. 6. Reduce heat to low and gradually stir in freshly grated Parmesan until smooth and creamy. 7. Season with black pepper and a pinch of nutmeg if desired. 8. Toss in the cooked pasta, adding a splash of reserved pasta water if needed to loosen the sauce. 9. Slice chicken and serve over the pasta. Finish with extra Parmesan and fresh parsley! A LITTLE TIP: Freshly grated Parmesan makes all the difference! Keep the sauce on low heat when adding the cheese so it stays silky and smooth. High-Protein Chicken Enchiladas 🌮 These are SO easy to make, packed with protein, and perfect for meal prep! I always double this recipe to make two trays so we have leftovers throughout the week! Ingredients: * 2½ lbs chicken breasts (or canned chicken or shredded rotisserie chicken!) * 1 bell pepper, diced * 1 onion, diced * ½ cup cottage cheese * ½ cup plain low-fat Greek yogurt * 2 cans enchilada sauce * 1 can diced green chilies * 8 low-carb tortillas * ¼–⅓ cup shredded cheddar cheese * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp chili powder * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * Salt & pepper, to taste Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Season your chicken with paprika, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Cook until fully cooked, then shred. 3. Dice your pepper and onion, season with the same spices, and sauté until softened. 4. In a large bowl, combine the shredded chicken, sautéed pepper and onion, cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, green chilies, and 1 whole can of enchilada sauce. Mix until well combined. 5. Spoon the mixture into your low-carb tortillas, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in a greased baking dish. 6. Pour additional enchilada sauce over the top (as much as you’d like!) and sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until heated through and the cheese is melted and bubbly! Shortcut: If you’re using canned chicken or shredded rotisserie chicken, skip cooking the chicken and simply mix it with the seasonings before adding it to your filling! Makes approximately 8 enchiladas! I always double the recipe and make two trays at once for easy lunches and dinners throughout the week!
